body:
no. 6 on hot country songs, her first country-radio single in seven years. "betty" went out on august 17, 2020 — pedal steel and harmonica, modeled on early dylan. it stayed a one-off. a postcard to the old neighborhood.

why: THIS SUPERSEDES the stuck 2026-08-09-august-augustine-ig.json — a "did you know" folklore draft whose scheduledAt had already passed unshipped. Rewritten as a fresh folklore heartbeat, rescheduled into the calendar window, on X so it needs no media at all (the queue-only PR cannot add a folklore image, and /eras/folklore.png is blocked as a recent-Instagram repeat). Subject deliberately changed: the "august"/Augustine story already shipped on X on 2026-08-09, so repeating it would be exactly the loop this rewrite exists to break. Hook "the number". Every claim traces to the Vault folklore item "betty goes to country radio — her first country single since 2013" (2020-08-17, sourced Wikipedia): sent to country radio Aug. 17 2020, her first on the format since the Red era, No. 6 on Hot Country Songs, the guitars/pedal steel/harmonica modeled on early Bob Dylan records, and that it stayed a one-off rather than a country return. The song’s co-write origin story is left out — it involves a private individual, and the chart fact carries the post without it. Trimmed to weighted ≤270 per X length rule. | 2026-08-12: campaign made story-unique — findPostedDuplicate matches platform+campaign, so shared thematic buckets false-skip every post after the first in the bucket (issue #2031 session finding).
